thread:
Maya Patel: Hey team — CumulusCore sent over the joint infographic for the Cloud Marketplace listing. Need quick brand + legal callouts before we send final assets to their marketing lead. PDF + source SVGs here: https://mocks.cumuluscore.com/redwood-co-marketing.zip :eyes:

Maya Patel: Main asks from their PM: confirm logo lockup, clearspace, alt text, and a short accreditation line (one sentence) we can include below the hero. They also want to use a single-slide infographic (1200x628) for the marketplace thumbnail — is that allowed? :question:

Jon Rivera: grabbing the files now. Quick glance — their logo has a gradient, need to confirm we can accept that treatment in co-branded lockup. Our brand guide prefers flat color marks on white/transparent backgrounds. Can we allow gradient in the thumbnail only? :thinking_face:

Leah Chen: Legal flag: must include our trademark attribution for product names and not imply endorsement beyond the integration. Draft accreditation line suggestion: "Redwood Inference and CumulusCore provide a jointly validated solution for low-latency LLM inference." I'll refine with our counsel if you want. :speech_balloon:

Ashwin Kapoor: Marketplace ops note — thumbnail 1200x628 is okay, but we need a 1:1 square (1024x1024) for listings in some stores. Also prefer PNG export with sRGB profile; SVG accepted for hero but not for some marketplace upload forms. Will need both. :computer:

Jon Rivera: Proposed lockup options in the ZIP: side-by-side, stacked, and seal. My preference: side-by-side on white for the primary, stacked for narrow widths. Need clearspace rule — suggest 1x height of Redwood wordmark. Attaching quick mock: `--redwood-clearspace: 1x;`

Maya Patel: Thanks. Leah — can you confirm whether the sentence below is ok for marketing legal? "Redwood Inference and CumulusCore collaborate to deliver a validated inference stack for enterprise workloads." If legal wants stronger limits (no endorsements) we'll update.

Leah Chen: That works as a starting point. Two tweaks: replace "collaborate" with "partner" and add a footnote for trademarks. Final: "Redwood Inference and CumulusCore partner to deliver a validated inference stack for enterprise workloads. Trademarks remain the property of their respective owners."

Jon Rivera: Design question — CumulusCore placed a customer quote bubble on the hero (no attribution). We need either a named quote or remove it. Also alt text for the infographic: suggested: "Diagram showing Redwood Inference and CumulusCore integration for low-latency LLM inference with caching and autoscale features."

Maya Patel: Good call. I'll ask them to confirm the quote source. Ashwin — can you add the file format checklist for them (PNG, SVG, 3x PNG for retina, 1024x1024 square)? I'll paste below what we need.

Ashwin Kapoor: Checklist (send to partner):
- Primary logo: SVG + flat PNG (transparent) at 600px width
- Co-brand lockups: SVG + PNG (white background)
- Infographic hero: PNG 1200x628 (sRGB) + 3x @3600x1884 for retina
- Square thumbnail: PNG 1024x1024
- Alt text (plain txt file) + caption line for marketplace
- Color palette swatches (HEX values)
- Permissions confirmation: partner confirms rights to use customer quotes/images

Maya Patel: Perfect. I'll send them this checklist and request a signed quote release for the testimonial. Jon — can you approve the lockup choices by EOD? Leah — legal final sign-off tomorrow morning? :thumbsup:

Jon Rivera: Yep — I'll pick the side-by-side (white background) and tidy the clearspace rules in the SVGs. Expect comments by 5pm. :white_check_mark:

Leah Chen: I can do legal review by 10am tomorrow. If they send the signed release and confirm the quote attribution, we're clear.

partnerships-bot: Checklist updated on the partnership tracker: https://internal.redwood.com/tracker/partners/CumulusCore — assigned to Maya, Jon, Leah. Reminder: include alt text and trademarks before publish. :robot_face:

Maya Patel: Sending checklist now. Will ping once CumulusCore responds with revised assets. Thanks all. :pray:
